issues.title: No tap-to-call link
issues.found: No tel: link was found on the homepage.
issues.why: Mobile visitors expect to tap the phone number and call straight away.
issues.fix: Make the phone number a tel: link in the header.

issues.title: Page title is too short or too long
issues.found: The title is 9 characters: "Wikipedia".
issues.why: Titles that are too short say too little in search results, and long titles get cut off.
issues.fix: Rewrite the title to about 50 to 60 characters with the service and the city.

issues.title: 7 of 7 images have no alt text
issues.found: 7 images have missing or empty alt text.
issues.why: Search engines and screen readers cannot tell what those images show.
issues.fix: Write one short alt description per image, naming the service shown.

issues.title: No canonical tag
issues.found: No canonical link tag was found.
issues.why: Search engines may treat similar pages as duplicates without one.
issues.fix: Add a canonical tag pointing at the page itself.

issues.title: No phone number visible on the homepage
issues.found: No phone number was found in the visible page text.
issues.why: Visitors who cannot see a number cannot call, and most will not hunt for a contact page.
